svg.title: Observables and comparison conditions in five studies published on 28 August 2026
svg.desc: A diagram of stationary-state accuracy and mixing for Gibbs preparation, XY diffusion and thermometry, exciton width, hybrid-qubit CZ infidelity, and geometric control. Rows correspond to references 1 through 5.
svg.text: Five studies and the quantities they tested
Each result connects an execution setting, an observable, and a comparison.

g.text: CLASSICAL NUMERICS
Gibbs thermal-state preparation [1]
Small-bath resets + modulated coupling · Ising: 16 spins · free fermions: hundreds of sites
Weak coupling: smaller stationary-state error, slower mixing in reset cycles.
ANALOG EXPERIMENT
2D XY spin diffusion [2]
Optical-lattice hard-core bosons · D = 0.82(3) Ja²/ℏ · 1σ fit uncertainty ±0.03
Density-correlation thermometry: J/T = 0.47 (+0.07, −0.09) · agreement with Dyn-HTE
SPECTROSCOPY
α-sexithiophene exciton [3]
Momentum-space data → real-space model · FWHM_x: 8.8 → 6.5 Å in 400 fs
Coherence across ~3 molecules · contraction consistent with exciton self-trapping
CLOSED-SYSTEM SIM.
Fluxonium–transmon architecture [4]
Fluxonium data qubits + transmon measurement ancillas · tunable couplers
Tunable spectator + DC mitigation · 50 ns CZ · closed-system avg. infidelity 5.6 × 10⁻⁵
THEORY + NUMERICS
Geometric diabatic–adiabatic pulses [5]
Selective multilevel transitions · one control → first-order ODE
Selected DQD example includes dephasing · GRAPE compared under specified conditions
